The '''Mournful Holocron''' was [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]] of the early [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] created by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Tresalis]]. The holocron contained information on the ways of [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]] and bedside manner, relayed to the user by the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]], a simulation of Tresalis herself. Because of Tresalis' overwhelming sadness at the loss of a loved one, the holocron received its name. In order to access the holocron, a user had to first console its gatekeeper and help the part of Tresalis imbued in the holocron cope with her loss.<ref name="SS" />

The holocron was believed to have been stored at the [[Jedi Enclave (Aloxl)|Jedi Enclave]] on [[Aloxl/Legends|Aloxl]], an ancient place from before the organization of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Rumor of the holocron's location was still spread after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SS" />
